en.title: Global Macro — Higher bond yields and divergent interest-rate decisions expose the limits of oil relief
en.deck: US job openings at 7.5 million, Treasury ten-year yields at 4.95%, an Australian rate hike, softer crude and Brazil's 1.42% equity decline show why lower energy futures are not yet broad financial easing.
en.regime: Resilient US vacancies and selected AI equities coexist with near-5% sovereign yields, Australian monetary tightening, cheaper oil futures and regional credit and currency stress.
en.key_risk: Mistaking lower oil futures and positive technology equity returns for confirmed disinflation or generalized credit easing.
